replies.body:
I've had a long, hard thought about this.

The thing is, they get attention from people who chose to acknowledge them. If everyone just minds their own business and realizes what the player is doing, then that person trying to attract heed from others is just going to be left alone in the dark. replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body:
I thought about this idea, and I like it.  However, it could show up on his/her's infractions, but it doesn't count as an infraction.  

For example: when a staff member warns himself to test that command, it shows up on his/her's infraction, but it isn't considered an infraction.  Same goes here.  For example: lest say I announce that I am leaving the server.  You DOOZiE see my post and type /leave Tarheelkiwi leaving the server (or something like that.)  Or if we couldn't make a new command, you could do /temp ban Tarheelkiwi leaving the server.  It would show up on my infractions, but I wouldn't be breaking any rules (assuming my leaving post is real and i am not trolling).  

But if my leaving post is a troll, you could do /ban Tarheelkiwi trolling staff or /ban Tarheelkiwi fake leaving post (which ever works).  This would show up on my infractions, but people would know that I did in fact break a rule.
